task: Productize Lattice Parallel Wave into read-only operator surfaces for dispatch manifests, wave status, serial merge queue, evidence report, and bounded dev-memory context.
outcome: User runs `koala parallel_dispatch --storyIds=["B-a","B-b"] --hosts=["codex","claude-code"] --includeExperience --format=json` and sees `schemaVersion:"koala.parallel_dispatch.v1"`, each entry has `dispatchable`, `agentRole`, `spawned:false`, `requiresRunnerConfirmation:true`, and `authority.productionDone:false`; then `koala parallel_merge_queue --format=json` shows ready/blocked serial merge guidance, and `npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-parallel-wave-smoke` ends with `✓ lattice parallel wave smoke passed`.
facts: B-29b6 already shipped parallel_wave_create, parallel_wave_inspect, and parallel_plan as read-only L0 planning surfaces.

The new commands must reuse existing wave story refs, host capability probes, dependency summaries, hotspot degradations, evidence refs, and authority boundary.
There is an active B-bffc story for CLI/App migration; this story must not modify or depend on B-bffc worktree state.
Future signed host-runner dispatch API acceptance is explicitly out of scope for this local operator projection.
Single-story multi-implementer sharding is explicitly left for a separate future productization story.
constraints: No automatic Codex/Claude/Gemini spawn from these CLI commands until a signed host-runner dispatch API exists.

Changes must stay inside the Lattice Parallel Wave/command registration/smoke/doc surface and avoid unrelated lifecycle rewrites.
